structured.answer: If anything, I'd take the "כספי (שקלי)" track: no shares, no foreign currency, all in shekels, 4.25% a year over 3 years, with a fee of about half a percent. But I'd ask my son or the bank whether that's really better than my deposit before I sign anything.
